name: @ep0ch/outliner
description: Persistent local-first block outliner shared by Herdr users and Pi agents

scripts.test:e2e:herdr: bun run test/e2e/startup-interruption.ts && bun run test/e2e/resource-authoring.ts
scripts.test:e2e:goto: bun run test/e2e/goto-search.ts && bun run test/e2e/goto-search.ts --composed
scripts.test:e2e:file-authority: bun run test/e2e/file-authority.ts && bun run test/e2e/file-authority.ts --ansi
scripts.test:e2e:tree-breadcrumbs: bun run test/e2e/tree-breadcrumbs.ts && bun run test/e2e/tree-breadcrumbs.ts --composed
scripts.test:e2e:tree-open-focus: bun run test/e2e/tree-open-focus.ts && bun run test/e2e/tree-open-focus.ts --ansi && bun run test/e2e/tree-open-focus.ts --composed
scripts.test:e2e:tree-roots: bun run test/e2e/tree-roots.ts && bun run test/e2e/tree-roots.ts --composed
scripts.test:e2e:tree-index: bun run test/e2e/tree-index.ts && bun run test/e2e/tree-index.ts --forwarded
scripts.test:e2e:detail-progressive: bun run test/e2e/detail-progressive.ts && bun run test/e2e/detail-progressive.ts --forwarded
scripts.test:e2e:composed: bun run test/e2e/composed-surface.ts && bun run test/e2e/composed-boundaries.ts && bun run test/e2e/reference-annotations.ts --composed && bun run test/e2e/annotation-threads.ts --composed
scripts.test:e2e:resource-occurrences: bun run test/e2e/resource-occurrences.ts && bun run test/e2e/resource-occurrences.ts --ansi
